title: B00GKIDZ v666 reborn hax
script:
-- no skidss
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "b00gkidzGUI"

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 300)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -150)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 6
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Frame.Active = true

-- Movimiento por deslizamiento
local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos

local function updateInput(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Frame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		updateInput(input)
	end
end)

-- Título
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 50)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Title.Text = "b00gkidz v666 reborn hax"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextScaled = true

-- Botón de cerrar
local Close = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
Close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
Close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
Close.Text = "X"
Close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Close.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Close.TextScaled = true
Close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
Close.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Close.BorderSizePixel = 2
Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Botón constructor
local function createButton(text, pos, func)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 40)
	button.Position = pos
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	button.BorderSizePixel = 4
	button.Text = text
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

-- Hint
createButton("hint", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 60), function()
	local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
	hint.Text = "Rc7 On top"
	hint.Parent = game.Workspace
	task.delay(3, function()
		hint:Destroy()
	end)
end)

-- Skybox
createButton("Skybox", UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 60), function()
	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.Name = "Rc7Sky"
	local asset = "rbxassetid://127221000626133"
	sky.SkyboxBk = asset
	sky.SkyboxDn = asset
	sky.SkyboxFt = asset
	sky.SkyboxLf = asset
	sky.SkyboxRt = asset
	sky.SkyboxUp = asset
	lighting:ClearAllChildren()
	sky.Parent = lighting
end)

-- Decal
createButton("Decal", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 120), function()
	for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Part") then
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://127221000626133"
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Parent = v
		end
	end
end)

-- Spooky theme
createButton("soundd", UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 120), function()
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://85271883712040"
	sound.Volume = 1
	sound.Looped = true
	sound:Play()

	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
	lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 5)
	lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	lighting.FogEnd = 100
	lighting.FogStart = 0
	lighting.Brightness = 0.5
end)

-- Partículas
createButton("Particles", UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 190), function()
	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	if player and player.Character then
		local character = player.Character
		local part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if part and not part:FindFirstChild("666Particles") then
			local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			particle.Name = "666Particles"
			particle.Texture = "rbxassetid://100174875638096"
			particle.Rate = 15
			particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1)
			particle.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			particle.Size = NumberSequence.new(2)
			particle.LightEmission = 0.5
			particle.Parent = part
		end
	end
end)
